title: The Twins' Assay Split
logline: Twin asteroid prospectors hire a neutral pilot to verify assay boundary markers across their contested family claim before the colonial probate board auctions the mineral rights.

roles.description: Twin asteroid driller; careful, resentful, insisting on following the precise terms of their mother's hand-drawn claim map.
Twin prospector; impulsive, heavily indebted to station card tables, trying to liquidate the claim quickly for cash.
Municipal estate officer tasked with auctioning contested inheritance titles if the heirs cannot agree.
The fraternal league of independent belt miners overseeing boundary dispute mediations.
A hollowed cuprite asteroid drifting on the outer ring edge where the family staked its claim.
The station administrative dock where estate disputes and mining titles are certified.

public_situation: A probate auction notice is posted for {role:contested_vein} after twin siblings file contradictory boundary claims with {role:probate_office}.
private_truth: {role:younger_twin} secretly forged their mother's codicil to assign the richest cuprite shaft exclusively to himself to pay off gambling debts.

beats.public_change: The probate board posts an eviction notice on the asteroid pylon, setting a thirty-six-hour deadline for assay certification.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to mine and deliver certified cuprite core samples from the contested vein to prove the claim is economically viable before the auction deadline.
missions.private_fact: He suspects his twin has been secretly selling unassayed ore off-station to settle personal card debts.

beats.public_change: {role:prospectors_union} convenes a field arbitration hearing as surveyors discover conflicting beacon timestamps on the asteroid surface.

missions.reason: He needs a pilot to scan the claim survey beacon memory banks and verify the digital timestamp of their mother's original claim stake.
missions.private_fact: The survey beacon holds his mother's deathbed voice recording asking the twins not to divide the claim.

beats.public_change: Bidding factors assemble outside {role:probate_office} while the clerk prepares the gavel for the final inheritance auction.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to deliver the true survey records and uncorrupted boundary deed to the probate clerk before the auctioneer calls the lot.
missions.private_fact: He is willing to forgive his brother's forgery if the younger twin agrees to work the shaft as equal partners.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands before the probate clerk as both twins wait in the concourse for the final ruling.

options.label: Submit the boundary proof and mandate an equal joint deed between the twins
Expose the younger twin's forgery and award the entire claim to the elder sibling
Allow the younger twin's debt collector to buy out the claim share for quick cash

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot tables the uncorrupted boundary surveys and enforces joint ownership.
resolutions.summary: The boundary proof establishes joint ownership. The twins agree to a mediated partnership under {role:prospectors_union}, preserving their family claim.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot recovered ancient asteroid survey marks to keep feuding twin brothers from losing their mother's mine.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot exposes the forgery to the probate clerk.
resolutions.summary: The forgery is documented before the clerk. {role:elder_twin} receives full title, while {role:younger_twin} is disinherited and flees station creditors.

consequences.public_summary: Miners talk about a pilot who uncovered forged digital deeds to stop a reckless prospector from stealing his brother's claim.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot lets creditors acquire the younger twin's share.
resolutions.summary: The younger twin's debt factor acquires half the claim. Commercial drillers move in, sidelining both siblings and driving family ties apart.

resolutions.reached_by: The survey proof is lost or the probate deadline expires.
resolutions.summary: The probate deadline passes without verified boundary surveys. {role:contested_vein} is auctioned off to corporate extractors, leaving both twins empty-handed.

loose_threads.detail: The probate bulletin contains a title registration stamped with an expired municipal notary certificate.
A station credit board posted an open debt lien matching the exact estimated value of the cuprite vein.
The claim beacon's telemetry transponder matches the serial number of a navigational buoy decommissioned thirty years ago.

radio_hooks: Probate court lists multiple contested belt mineral claims for mandatory public auction.
Prospectors union issues stern advisory regarding fraudulent boundary beacon modifications.
Exchange commodities desk reports steady demand for verified high-purity cuprite core samples.

voice_direction.elder_twin: Stiff, weary, and pedantic. Speaks with meticulous attention to survey coordinates and shows bitter grief whenever mentioning his brother.
voice_direction.younger_twin: Fast-talking, nervous, and defensive. Dismisses serious accusations with casual jokes and shifts blame to station bookmakers and equipment leases.
